content_sections.heading: EdCIL Rajasthan PMU Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will be based on academic/professional qualifications and post-qualification experience, and will also include an Interview, as may be decided depending on the total number of eligible applicants. Merely fulfilling the eligibility criteria does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. A waiting list will also be prepared for each category of consultant/other position, so that if a selected candidate does not join, or if any consequential vacancy arises, suitable candidates from the waiting list will be given the opportunity to join, based on experience and qualifications. Engagement of the selected consultants/other posts will be purely on a contractual (full-time) basis for a period of 1 year, which may be extended by 1 more year for providing high-quality services on specific projects, as per the requirement of the Ministry of Education (MoE) and the performance of the individual. This engagement does not vest any right in the candidate to claim regular appointment, permanent absorption, or continued contractual appointment.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for EdCIL Rajasthan PMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Documents to prove Qualification, post-qualification Experience, Age, etc., must be produced in original when called for interview. At the time of applying, candidates must upload documents relating to Education, post-qualification Experience, Photograph, and Resume, only in PDF format. Candidates working in a Government organisation/Public Sector Enterprise/Autonomous Body must route their application through proper channel, if their department's rules require this.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for EdCIL Rajasthan PMU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Online Resource Pool Portal. No other mode of application will be accepted. Call letters and other intimations connected with this recruitment will be sent only to shortlisted candidates by e-mail, as provided in their online application form. Candidates should ensure that the e-mail ID given in their application remains active throughout the recruitment process.

faq.question: Q1. What is EdCIL Rajasthan PMU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is Advertisement No. EdCIL/TSG/Rajasthan/PMU-SS/2026-01 issued by EdCIL (India) Limited, inviting online applications for 57 contractual posts – Chief Consultant, Consultant, Associate Consultant/Data Analyst, District Consultant, and Coordinator – for the PMU under Samagra Shiksha & STARS, Rajasthan Project.

faq.answer: A total of 57 positions are available: 2 Chief Consultant, 10 Consultant (across three fee levels), 2 Associate Consultant/Data Analyst, 41 District Consultant, and 2 Coordinator posts.

faq.answer: The last date for receipt of the online application is 24 August 2026. The application form has been available since 11 August 2026.

faq.answer: The maximum age limit ranges from 42 years (District Consultant, Coordinator, Associate Consultant/Data Analyst) to 55 years (Chief Consultant), reckoned as on 01 April 2026, depending on the post.

faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online only, through the Resource Pool Portal at https://tsgrecruitment.edcil.co.in/. Candidates applying for more than one post must submit a separate application for each post.
